method: Manual review of every verbatim whole-stream local ASR transcript against frozen expected facts. No trimming, reruns, normalization or failed-case exclusions.

limits: ASR is an automatic content proxy, not human listening or an intelligibility score.
Proper-name renderings differ in every transcript; this cannot isolate TTS pronunciation from ASR recognition.
Received PCM and completed handles do not prove every transmitted frame was received or physical playback completion.
The same production recognizer and synthetic input were reused; no independent held-out accuracy claim.
